scope: One baseline JPEG coefficient-block primitive; two frozen JPEG inputs from one original 513x259 raster. Single CPU warm public decode to independent RGBA8. No uniform parity claim.
changedPrimitive: Separate baseline coefficient-block decoding after existing scan admission (SS=0, SE=63, Ah=Al=0), according to T.81 F.2.2. Constant baseline AC band and amplitude shifts remove progressive/refinement machinery from this loop. Preserve DC categories and predictor bounds, AC categories, zero runs, end-of-block and exact symbol/amplitude/error traversal. Original progressive loop, Huffman/reader primitives, MCU/restart handling, work/cancellation, geometry/orientation, rendering and independent output ownership remain. No new storage, tables, caches, allocations or dependencies.

baseline.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit 4:4:4 JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.
